lines.trans: Just swapping out the organic eggs — that's where I draw the line too!
Hello again! Is this checkout lane open now?
Yes, come on over! I'm just opening up.
That comes to nine euros fifty then, please.
Here is ten euros. Keep the change!
Oh, thanks! And what is written on this slip of paper?
That is my number. Feel free to give me a call sometime.
Only please don't call before six o'clock in the evening!
